question: With the forecast cutoff placed at the causal release event (OW-EVENT-20 detector) instead of the fixed 2.0 s wall-clock cutoff, how do persistence, OLS velocity and gravity-only continuation compare at 50/100/200 ms within each development participant/session, and is the ranking between candidates more consistent across participants/sessions than at the fixed cutoff on the same trials?
evidence_class: development only. P0001-P0003 shaped the OW-EVENT-20 detector and its noncausal post-event fits on these trials were already seen (gravity preferred over constant velocity in 11/88, 22/93, 42/90 of the 2025 windows), so this is neither blind nor confirmatory. A confirmatory claim needs newly captured data: P0004's one consultation is spent and P0005 stays locked.

not_opened.P0004: its one permitted consultation was spent in OW-REGIME-19

event_detector.rule: OW-EVENT-20 detect_release unchanged (2r contact boundary, 1.6-frame gap, 200 ms ascending window, integer milliseconds, hand keypoints and ball from its load_inputs). The event sample is shifted onto the baseline cutoff (2.0 s) by integer-millisecond arithmetic.

event20_reproduction.rule: every trial's event status and event_time_s, and every event-anchored prefix status, must equal OW-EVENT-20's retained row exactly or the run blocks

candidates.rule: OW-REGIME-18 freeze_trial and score_trial unchanged: persistence (last admitted prefix sample), velocity (OLS intercept at the cutoff plus velocity times (target time - cutoff)), gravity (fit_gravity_ballistic_segment on the admitted prefix, predicted at the native target time). Eligibility is the unchanged baseline fit_prefix/target_index. No new candidate, threshold, switch or learned model.

arms.event: the candidates frozen on the event-shifted time axis
arms.fixed: the same candidates frozen on OW-REGIME-17's load_trial time axis (fixed 2.0 s cutoff), recomputed from the data in this run

regime18_reproduction.rule: every fixed-arm prefix status, the set of scored horizons and every per-horizon candidate error must equal OW-REGIME-18's retained row exactly or the run blocks

freeze: both arms' prefix fits, native target times and predictions for every trial are written to frozen_predictions.json and hashed before any reference position is read for scoring; the hash is re-checked after scoring
metrics: 3-D Euclidean error (m) against the supplied track at the first native sample at or after each horizon (within one frame). Per arm x view x group x horizon: n, target-unavailability reasons, mean/median/p90 per candidate, and per contrast the mean/median/p90 of the per-trial paired difference with a percentile bootstrap 95% CI of the mean over trials. Empty cells are null, never zero.

views.all: every trial scored in that arm at that horizon
views.common: trials scored in both arms at that horizon, so the two anchors are compared on identical trials

label_rule: per contrast a_minus_b: a_lower if the CI upper bound is below 0; b_lower if the CI lower bound is above 0; not_separated otherwise; undefined if n = 0. Labels describe these development trials; they are not population decisions.
consistency_rule: per arm x view x horizon x contrast: consistent if all four participant/session groups carry the same defined label, otherwise inconsistent. Key reported quantity (fixed before scoring): gravity_minus_velocity at 200 ms in the common view, for both arms, with the per-group means and intervals.
cohort_accounting: per arm x horizon, wms.evaluation.evidence_contracts.reconcile_cohort accounts for all 396 trials exactly once: accepted = scored; rejected = event, prefix or target status
examples: per participant/session in the event arm: the trial with the lower-median 200 ms velocity error (representative) and the one with the maximum (failure), ties broken by path; plotted as ball height against time since the event with the admitted prefix, all three predictions and the supplied reference
verification: verify-retained checks digests, replays the frozen config, checks the freeze hash, re-scores every frozen prediction against the retained reference positions, rebuilds the summary and cohort accounting; with --data-root and --inventory it also re-derives every frozen row and reference from the pinned data
